rav.text: Teysa Karlov, baroness of the Utvara Reclamation Zone, helped stop Zomaj Hauc's schemes with an assembled force and a controlled dragon.
She had been made a puppet of the Obzedat by Melisk, whose taj made her kill her uncle, but when she learned of his treachery she took control of the taj and he was dismembered.
After the Guildpact was broken, Teysa drafted a new non-magical document for cooperation, and later she asked Tajic to help remove the Obzedat, though the plot failed.

gpt.text: Teysa's uncle made her baroness of Utvara, and they traveled there by lokopede with Melisk and Crix.

She charged Dr. Nebun with curing the Kuga plague, and after discovering that Melisk had been erasing her memory and that her uncle's death was an Obzedat scheme, she broke her oath and rallied Utvara against the Cauldron.
Teysa broke into the Cauldron and read Crix's spell to command the last dragon, and in a dogfight Hauc died and the two dragons killed each other.

dgm.text: An angel brought Teysa Karlov a message from the ghost halls of the Obzedat, saying she must find the correct route and complete the maze at all costs.
Teysa completed the Implicit Maze, and after Jace linked the maze-runners' minds, the Supreme Verdict was triggered.

rna.text: Teysa convened a meeting of the Obzedat, but Kaya ended it, and when Kaya freed bound ghosts from debt against Teysa's warning, the hierarchs pressured Teysa to arrest her.
Kaya and Teysa witnessed the guild summit's dissolution after Isperia's murder, and then Kaya turned the tables on the hierarchs and had Teysa arrested.

mkm.text: Teysa hosted a gala at Karlov Manor and told Kaya she owed the Orzhov that night, but a scream from inside the manor interrupted her, and her party ended when Zegana was found murdered.
Then Kaya found Teysa dead in her private parlor, stabbed with her own walking stick, with a note in Phyrexian script.
Proft deduced that a mind-controlled hitman killed her through a plant cultivated by Oba, who believed Teysa had collaborated with the Phyrexians.
Teysa returned as a ghost, appeared at her funeral, retook control of the Syndicate and recommended that Kaya leave the plane.
